name: Choco Tsuku!
source:
I'm Nekomiya Meno, a high school freshman. I was casually enjoying my school life until around February, when I met two older guys - Miyashita Ryuu, known for being a 'bad boy', and Kawamori Kazuki, who's calm, collected and popular with girls.

After falling in love with one of them, I decided. I have to make up my mind who to confess to, and then make chocolate for Valentine's Day!

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/4557]Freem![/url]]
translation:
我叫猫宫芽之，是个高一女生。原本我正悠闲地享受着校园生活，直到二月前后，遇见了两位学长——以“不良少年”闻名的宫下龙，以及冷静沉着、很受女生欢迎的川森和树。

喜欢上其中一位学长后，我下定了决心。我要选好告白的对象，然后亲手制作情人节巧克力！

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/4557]Freem![/url]]
